result.title: ET: Efficient Transfer from Softmax to Hybrid Attention
result.summary: Converting pretrained softmax Transformers to efficient attention often causes substantial performance degradation, while recovery typically requires costly fine-tuning. We propose ET (Efficient Transfer), a framework for high-fidelity attention conversion with minimal optimization cost. ET combines exact local and shared-key softmax attention with a mean-anchored, scan-free global linear correction and adaptive gating, achieving linear complexity in sequence length. To preserve pretrained knowledge, ET freezes pretrained weights and calibrates only newly introduced parameters through alternating least squares on a small set of unlabeled samples, without gradient updates. On ImageNet-1K, ET achieves 79.64% and 81.55% top-1 accuracy on DeiT-S and DeiT-B, respectively, within 0.25 percentage points of their softmax teachers. At $768\times768$, ET outperforms T$^5$ by 3.59 percentage points at comparable inference FLOPs, without gradient-based fine-tuning. On DiT-XL/2, ET achieves an FID-50K of 2.59 with only 250 LoRA updates. On Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium, ET matches the teacher's GenEval score at 1K resolution with just 0.73 A100 GPU-hours of gradient-free conversion and a 1.39$\times$ inference speedup.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ET 框架，将预训练 softmax Transformer 转换为混合注意力（精确局部 softmax、共享键 softmax 加线性全局校正与自适应门控），并用交替最小二乘在少量无标签样本上无梯度校准新参数，在 DeiT、DiT、SD3.5 上验证高保真转换与推理加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文关注注意力结构替换与免梯度参数校准的效率问题，未涉及 latent 推理状态的生成、使用或多模态证据筛选，与 LVR 主线缺少具体联系。
